_note: Reviewed mapping and the ONLY source of titles, skill groups and publish tiers for the hand-pose samples; the build and render scripts read nothing else for these. Review it whenever a sample is added or a tier changes (data team + the person who signs off public previews). Skill groups follow the data team's labels. Titles stay generic: task level only, no people, places or businesses. Tiers are decided by the data team and the privacy review, not by this code: 'video' = camera video with the hand pose drawn over it, faces and bystanders blurred (render-overlay.py), plus the card loop; 'poster' = skeleton still only, no camera pixels; 'lane' = metrics and state lane only, no media at all. 'pack' = the gated sample pack. Consent for each public video is to be confirmed before production. 04 stays 'lane': a customer under the hands and a phone screen in view. 16 stays 'poster': the cards being cut carry a business name, in the hands. To change a tier, edit this file, then re-run render-overlay.py (or render-skeleton.py) and build-handpose-data.py.
